name: ss2ntk_trino_202605_06
sql:
/*
================================================================================
项目名称 : 星矢东南亚、星矢繁体、新三国 2026年 5-6月 月度 KPI 统计 SQL (人民币 RMB 口径)
数据源   : 数数 / Trino (ThinkingData TA)
================================================================================
*/

WITH ScanConfig AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2026-05-01' AS target_start_date,
        DATE '2026-06-30' AS target_end_date
),

UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#varchar_id" AS account_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_19
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('is_water')
),

RawEvents AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN v.applicationid IN ('23000113', 'seiya30tw')
              OR v.productid IN ('23000113', 'seiya30tw')
              OR regexp_extract(v.lcxproductid, 'g(\d+)', 1) IN ('23000113')
              OR substring(v.affcode, -8) IN ('23000113')
              OR regexp_extract(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(CAST(v.payload AS JSON), '$.productid'), 'g(\d+)', 1) IN ('23000113', 'seiya30tw')
            THEN '星矢繁体'
            WHEN v.applicationid IN ('60000001')
              OR v.productid IN ('60000001')
              OR regexp_extract(v.lcxproductid, 'g(\d+)', 1) IN ('60000001')
              OR substring(v.affcode, -8) IN ('60000001')
              OR regexp_extract(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(CAST(v.payload AS JSON), '$.productid'), 'g(\d+)', 1) IN ('60000001')
            THEN '星矢东南亚'
            WHEN v.applicationid IN ('65002004')
              OR v.productid IN ('65002004')
              OR regexp_extract(v.lcxproductid, 'g(\d+)', 1) IN ('65002004')
              OR substring(v.affcode, -8) IN ('65002004')
              OR regexp_extract(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(CAST(v.payload AS JSON), '$.productid'), 'g(\d+)', 1) IN ('65002004')
            THEN '新三国'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS game,
        SUBSTR(v."$part_date", 1, 7) AS month,
        CAST(v."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) AS account_id,
        v."$part_event" AS part_event,
        v."$part_date" AS part_date,
        v.payload
    FROM ta.v_event_19 v
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON CAST(v."#account_id" AS VARCHAR) = b.account_id
    WHERE b.account_id IS NULL
      AND v."$part_date" >= '2026-01-01'
      AND v."$part_event" IN ('NUU', 'LOGIN_SUCCESS', 'PURCHASE')
),

UserReg AS (
    SELECT
        game,
        account_id,
        MIN(month) AS reg_month
    FROM RawEvents
    WHERE game IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY game, account_id
),

MonthlyActiveUsers AS (
    SELECT
        e.game,
        e.month,
        e.account_id,
        CASE WHEN r.reg_month = e.month THEN 'NUU' ELSE 'OLD' END AS user_type
    FROM RawEvents e
    JOIN UserReg r ON e.game = r.game AND e.account_id = r.account_id
    WHERE e.game IS NOT NULL
      AND e.month BETWEEN '2026-05' AND '2026-06'
      AND e.part_event IN ('NUU', 'LOGIN_SUCCESS')
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
),

MonthlyRevenue AS (
    SELECT
        e.game,
        e.month,
        SUM(
            CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(CAST(e.payload AS JSON), '$.curamt') AS DOUBLE) 
            / COALESCE(ex.exchange, 1.0) * COALESCE(ex_cny.exchange, 1.0)
        ) AS total_sales,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN r.reg_month = e.month THEN
                CAST(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(CAST(e.payload AS JSON), '$.curamt') AS DOUBLE) 
                / COALESCE(ex.exchange, 1.0) * COALESCE(ex_cny.exchange, 1.0)
            ELSE 0.0 END
        ) AS nuu_sales
    FROM RawEvents e
    JOIN UserReg r ON e.game = r.game AND e.account_id = r.account_id
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange ex 
        ON e.part_date = ex.ex_date 
       AND JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(CAST(e.payload AS JSON), '$.cur') = ex.currency
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange ex_cny 
        ON e.part_date = ex_cny.ex_date 
       AND ex_cny.currency = 'CNY'
    WHERE e.game IS NOT NULL
      AND e.month BETWEEN '2026-05' AND '2026-06'
      AND e.part_event = 'PURCHASE'
      AND JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(CAST(e.payload AS JSON), '$.validationtype') <> 'SANDBOX_RECEIPT'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),

MonthlyUserAgg AS (
    SELECT
        game,
        month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS mau,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type = 'NUU' THEN account_id END) AS nuu,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN user_type = 'OLD' THEN account_id END) AS old_users
    FROM MonthlyActiveUsers
    GROUP BY game, month
),

JoinedMonthlyKPI AS (
    SELECT
        u.game,
        u.month,
        COALESCE(r.total_sales, 0.0) AS sales,
        u.mau,
        u.nuu,
        COALESCE(r.nuu_sales, 0.0) AS nuu_sales,
        u.old_users,
        LAG(u.mau, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY u.game ORDER BY u.month ASC) AS prev_mau
    FROM MonthlyUserAgg u
    LEFT JOIN MonthlyRevenue r ON u.game = r.game AND u.month = r.month
)

SELECT
    game AS game,
    month AS month,
    ROUND(sales, 2) AS sales_rmb,
    mau AS mau,
    nuu AS nuu,
    ROUND(nuu_sales, 2) AS nuu_sales_rmb,
    ROUND(nuu_sales * 100.0 / NULLIF(sales, 0), 2) AS nuu_ratio,
    ROUND(nuu_sales / NULLIF(nuu, 0), 2) AS nuu_arpu_rmb,
    old_users AS old_users,
    ROUND(old_users * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev_mau, 0), 2) AS old_retention_ratio,
    ROUND((sales - nuu_sales) / NULLIF(old_users, 0), 2) AS old_arpu_rmb
FROM JoinedMonthlyKPI
ORDER BY game, month;
